title: Ba’aa Qabeenyaa
intro: Oduu qabeenya guddaa, jireenya warqee fi humnaan faayame, garuu dhumarratti warra guddina addunyaa barbaadan hundaaf barumsa of eeggannoo ta’e fuuldura dhaabbatta. Eenyummaa nama seenaan isaa yeroon sagalee dhageessisu, qabeenya addunyaa yeroo muraasaaf darbuu isaaf ragaa ta’e kanaa hiikuu dandeessaa?
clues: Ani ummata Nabiyyii guddaa irraan ture, garuu daandii of tuulummaa fi cunqursaa filadhe.
Rabbiin qabeenya guddaa naaf kenne, hanga furtuun qabeenya koo garee dhiirotaa cimaa tokkoof ba’aa guddaa natti ta’e.
Ummanni kiyya badhaadhummaa kootti akkan hin gammadne na gorsan, Rabbiin nama gammachuu qabu akka hin jaallanne na yaadachiise.
Qabeenyi koo bal’aan beekumsaa fi carraaqqii mataa kootiin malee, barakaa Rabbiin irraa argadhe miti jedheen of tuulummaadhaan himadhe.
Malaammaltummaa irraa akeekkachiifamee waan Rabbiin naaf kenneen Aakhira akkan barbaadu na yaadachiifame, garuu dhaggeeffachuu didee of tuuluun itti fufe.
Dhuma irrattis Rabbiin dachii akka na fi mana jireenyaa koo liqimsitu godhee, gargaartota murtoo Isaa irratti hin hafne.
verse: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no body of supporters to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who could defend themselves. (Al-Qasas 28:81)
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
